## 1. Verdict

Band-3's first authored batch (76 nodes) is **fundamentally sound**. Doctrine #4 (an upgrade
must never share a node with its own base part) was checked exhaustively across all 76 nodes
by all 6 agents — **zero violations**. `tools/build_tree.py` prints `design checks: clean`
(217 nodes, 19 disciplines, no warnings). Tier jumps are almost all justified or already
self-documented in-file as pending (the fission-reactor gap, the lander-legs/fuel-crossfeed
late scheduling). Three of `docs/BAND3-TREE.md`'s own open questions resolved cleanly in the
final authoring (`gnc_threeAxisStabilizedBus`'s weak parent, the SR19/SR73/Alcyone1/M55 solid
placements, the Viking blend). The real defect count is modest for 76 nodes — comparable in
scale to band-1's review (6 of 30 candidates survived there; here, 14 of ~24, but most are
Low/Medium naming or bookkeeping issues, not structural breaks). The one node that stacks
multiple real problems is `int_geminiCapsule`.

## 2. High-confidence findings

### `int_geminiCapsule` — mis-homed part + reversed naming decision
**[High]** *(confirmed independently by two agents: the capsule-lane review and the
cross-cutting sweep)*
- Title is **"Orbital Attitude and Maneuvering Propulsion"** — this is literally the real
  part's own name copied in: `ROC-GeminiOAMSBDB` = *"Gemini Orbit Attitude and Maneuvering
  System (SE-7-100)"*. It's an artifact name (rule 5 bans this), an unlabeled "X and Y"
  compound, and it **reverses `docs/BAND3-TREE.md`'s own explicit rename decision**
  ("Maneuverable Orbital Cabin" → "Powered Orbital Maneuvering," specifically because
  "maneuverable was a capability claim") — the currently-shipped title isn't even one of the
  doc's two candidates.
- Parts list has grown to **8** (over the hard 6-part cap; sibling `int_mercuryCapsule` is
  documented at "6 parts, at the cap"). The 8th, `USMatBayWedge` = **"Crewed Experiment Bay"**
  (UniversalStorage2, category=Science), is a science-experiment locker with no relation to
  OAMS propulsion — every other UniversalStorage2 wedge in the tree homes at its own
  science-mechanism node (`USThermoBaroWedge`→`mic_atmoSounding`, `USGooBayWedge`→
  `bio_cultures`, `USAccelGravWedge`→`gnc_orbitalGravimetry`), and this node's own edit history
  shows the antenna was deliberately pulled OUT for the same reason — no comment explains why
  this one stayed in.
- **Fix:** rename to "Powered Orbital Maneuvering" (or equivalent mechanism name); relocate
  `USMatBayWedge` to a crewed-science-instrument node, restoring the 7-part count.
- Maybe-intentional: No — nothing in the comment trail justifies either the title or the part.

### `pc_caveaB` — flavor text is factually wrong
**[High]**
Flavor claims "a small edge over the operational choices, for whoever wants to gamble on it
anyway." Ground truth (`RCS_Config.cfg`/`engine-stats.tsv`): Cavea-B (`thrusterPower=0.425`,
`IspV=0.939`) is **worse than all five operational alternatives in the same node** — even the
weakest operational option (UDMH+NTO, IspV=0.943) beats it. The "never left the bench" framing
is accurate; the "edge" claim is backwards.
- **Fix:** rewrite the flavor to frame Cavea-B as a worse-performing period curiosity, not an
  edge.
- Maybe-intentional: No — directly contradicted by the same source file the design doc cites.

### `gnc_interplanetaryAvionics` / `gnc_improvedAvionics` / `gnc_matureAvionics` — naming drift
**[High]**
Titled "Interplanetary Avionics Tier" / "Improved Avionics Tier" / "Mature Avionics Tier" — the
raw RP-1 tech-node name plus "Tier," breaking 4-for-4 precedent in the same ladder
(`gnc_postWarAvionics`="Gyroscopic Autopilot", `gnc_avionicsPrototypes`="Analog Inertial
Guidance", etc., all of which invented a real mechanism name) and contradicting
`docs/PLACEHOLDERS.md`'s own template comment ("name the enabling breakthrough, per the naming
gate"). Tier order/eras are correct (verified against real RP-1 x-values) — only the naming is
wrong.
- **Fix:** rename to real mechanism names consistent with early-60s probe avionics (e.g.
  solid-state flight computers, redundant electronics), matching the sibling nodes' style.
- Maybe-intentional: No.

### `gnc_threeAxisStabilizedBus` — two ride-along parts one to two eras too early
**[High]**
Real anchor parts (`ca_argo-mk2*`, `sp_mariner_a`) all sit at RP-1 x=-2952, matching this
node's T7. But `SXTAlouetteI` ("Alouette Core") sits at x=-2867 — one generation later,
the same era seeding `gnc_improvedAvionics` (T8) — and `sp_mariner_b` ("CA-E100-SPV 1x2 Solar
Panel," near-identical name to the correctly-placed `sp_mariner_a`) sits at x=-2612, two
generations later. This is the **third** instance of the project's own recurring "check era for
every member before merging" lesson being missed in this exact batch (the antenna-catalog split
caught and fixed the same mistake once already, with a comment recording it — no equivalent
comment covers these two).
- **Fix:** move `SXTAlouetteI` to a T8 GuidanceControl node; move `sp_mariner_b` to an
  appropriately later power/antenna node.
- Maybe-intentional: Partial — the node's comment defends bundling `SXTAlouetteI` rather than
  giving it its own node, but that justifies not splitting it, not skipping the era check; no
  comment addresses `sp_mariner_b` at all.

## 3. Medium-confidence findings

- **`av_mach2Turbojet`** — "Mach-2-Class Turbojet" names a performance capability; grepping all
  217 node titles in the tree, no other node uses a "Mach-N"/"-Class" pattern — a unique
  outlier, the same anti-pattern as "orbital-class thrust." Rename to the mechanism (e.g.
  "Sustained-Cruise Afterburning Turbojet"). **[High within its lane, listed Medium overall
  since it's cosmetic, not structural.]**
- **`pc_scoutMarkII`** — title "Composite-Binder Solid Stages" claims a binder-chemistry
  breakthrough, but ground truth shows Algol-I/II are both `PUPE` (no change) and
  Antares-I/II are both `PBAA` (no change) — only Altair actually goes PSPC→PBAA→PBAN.
  `docs/BAND3-TREE.md`'s naming justification only verified Altair's chain, not the node's own
  king (`ROE-Algol2`). Needs a mechanism name true for all three families, or a re-look at
  whether Algol2/Antares2 belong here at all.
- **`pc_allSolidStaging`** — "Instant-Readiness Solid Staging" names the outcome ("ready the
  instant the order comes"), not the mechanism (stacking three solid stages instead of
  mixed liquid+solid) — the exact drift the same authoring pass already caught and fixed once
  for `fd_pressureFedRestart` ("reliability is the outcome, not the mechanism"). *(Converged:
  flagged independently by both the PropellantChemistry lane agent and the cross-cutting
  sweep.)*
- **`pc_apogeeKickStage`** — 8 real parts (Star13D/13/13A/37/37E/17/17A + SXTWaxWing), over the
  hard max-6 rule. The node's own comment self-labels the Star-17/Waxwing tail as
  "CATALOG (cap-exempt)," but that's an author's in-line claim, not a canonical INTENTIONAL-list
  exemption — sibling solid-motor nodes in the same batch all respected the cap. Split the tail
  into its own dead-end node, or get the exemption formally recorded.
- **`int_compactCrewPod`** — its own comment already flagged the `landerCabinSmall`+
  `ShieldCapLarge` pairing as unconfirmed; ground-truthing **confirms it's actually wrong** —
  Mk1 lander can (Squad) paired with a Mk2 pod cover (VenStockRevamp), two incompatible catalog
  families. Title is also a bare artifact/capability name ("Compact Crew Pod"). Needs a real
  Mk1-compatible cover or should drop the pairing until one's found.
- **`rob_surfaceMobility` / `fd_lunarSurfaceMobility`** — both titled around "Mobility," an
  outcome word, not the mechanism (wheel-hub motor drive; throttleable propulsive hop,
  respectively). `fd_lunarSurfaceMobility`'s thinness is self-acknowledged as deliberately
  provisional in-file; `rob_surfaceMobility` breaks its own sibling batch's consistent
  mechanism-suffix convention (Actuation/Extension/Servo/Sequencing).

  `str_fixedLanderLegs`'s similarly large jump (which is explicitly justified in-file).

## 6. Confirmed resolutions (previously-open questions, now correctly closed)

- **`gnc_threeAxisStabilizedBus` parent edge** — `docs/BAND3-TREE.md` flagged parenting this off
  `hire_JPL + pc_pioneerUpperStage` as its weakest edge and proposed `gnc_spacecraftRCS`
  instead. The shipped tree uses `gnc_spacecraftRCS` alone — resolved exactly as proposed, and
  taken one step further (the `hire_JPL` charter-crossover was also dropped, consistent with the
  standing rule that the charter subtree never cross-depends into the main tree).
- **ROE-SR19/ROE-SR73** — re-identified with real thrust data as Minuteman III's stages and
  moved into a new node (`pc_allSolidStaging`), not left as a guessed grouping.
- **ROE-Alcyone1** — placed in `pc_doubleBaseBooster` (band-2) after correctly reading its NGNC
  propellant code as double-base chemistry, with a comment recording the reasoning. Not
  orphaned.
- **M55** — moved out of `pc_strapOnMarkII` into `pc_allSolidStaging`, leaving
  `pc_strapOnMarkII` a clean confirmed PSPC→PBAA lineage (Castor1→Castor2).
- **Viking `UH25+NTO` blend** — the doc proposed skipping it as a performance wash; the shipped
  tree instead placed it in `fd_blendedStorableFuel` backed by real +8-9% thrust deltas, a
  better-informed reversal of the original guess.
- **`nuc_nuclearThermalRocket`/`nuc_nuclearRamjet`'s 8-tier and 5-tier jumps** — both carry
  explicit in-file comments ("PENDING: a fission-reactor parent... joins later and closes the
  gap") — self-documented as incomplete, not silently broken.
- **`fd_continuousThrottleDescent`** authored under FluidDynamics rather than the doc's proposed
  EntryDescentLanding discipline — a deliberate, sensible correction (its payload is engine
  hardware; EDL is used elsewhere for airbags/heatshields/parachutes, not engines).

- `gnc_rendezvousDocking` "Rendezvous and Docking" — an "X and Y" title, but a real standing
  aerospace term, same exception class as GN&C.
- All 93 parent→child tier gaps among the 76 nodes were census'd: `{1: 36, 2: 18, 3: 25, 4: 8,
  5: 3, 6: 2, 8: 1}`. Every gap ≥5 is individually justified (see §6) or matches the
  established "commitment gate" pattern (`elec_fuelCellPower`/`nuc_isotopePower` hanging

- Doctrine #4 (upgrade sharing a node with its own base part) — checked exhaustively across
